title: test(dogfood): flip the three hook-abort pins to the ruled HOOK_ABORTED wire
body:
Fixes #27806

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:把两个 dogfood 测试文件里三处仍断言"hook 中止不带 code"的旧线形 pin,翻成裁决后的 `code: 'HOOK_ABORTED'`;句子原文与"未写入任何行"的断言原样保留。
- 为什么改:#27667 按裁决(#27597,6431311681 letter A)让未声明 code 的 hook 中止在 /data 门回 `HOOK_ABORTED`,这三处 pin 没跟上,main 每次跑 Dogfood 分片 1/3 都红。
- 风险与回滚:只改测试断言与注释,不动产品代码、不跳过、不放宽;回滚即 revert 本 PR(main 会重新变红)。
- 先看:`packages/qa/dogfood/test/object-hook-lifecycle-scratch.dogfood.test.ts`(acceptance[6] 的 deep-equal)、`packages/qa/dogfood/test/error-sentences-live.dogfood.test.ts`(acceptance[1] 两个写门的 code 断言)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/error-sentences-live.dogfood.test.ts test/object-hook-lifecycle-scratch.dogfood.test.ts`,预期 2 个文件、8 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

A stop-bleed for the main-red `Dogfood Regression Gate (1/3)` since `21c4bdd8`. #27667 made an undeclared hook abort answer the /data write door with `code: 'HOOK_ABORTED'` (ruling `6431311681` letter A on #27597; a declared code is kept). Three pins still asserted the old code-less body. Each now asserts the ruled wire:

- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/error-sentences-live.dogfood.test.ts`, acceptance[1], for `POST /data/OBJECT` and `POST /data/OBJECT/createMany` (two pins, one per door). It was `'code' in body` is false. It is now `body.code` is `'HOOK_ABORTED'`. The `body.error === HOOK_SENTENCE` assert and the nothing-written assert stay. The case title and the header comment now name the ruled wire.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/object-hook-lifecycle-scratch.dogfood.test.ts`, acceptance[6] / negative[0]. The deep-equal is now `{ error: ABORT_MSG, code: 'HOOK_ABORTED', object: ABORT }`. The no-unhandled-error log assert and the no-row assert stay. The comment cites #27597.

No skip, no `.todo`, no retry, no product change, and no other test touched. The spelling follows the existing pin at `hook-error-format.dogfood.test.ts:124`.

## Tests

All runs used the dependency closure built locally (`pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build`, lock VERDICT command-exit 0).

- **Red reproduced at origin/main `0a4b0fb223`, before any edit:** the two files gave `Tests 3 failed | 5 passed (8)`. The failures are exactly the three pins:
  - `error-sentences-live.dogfood.test.ts:79` failed for both doors. Received `{"error":"A budget line needs an approver before it can be recorded.","code":"HOOK_ABORTED","object":"errsent_budget"}`.
  - `object-hook-lifecycle-scratch.dogfood.test.ts:134` failed. The diff was `+ "code": "HOOK_ABORTED"`.
- **Green after the flip:** `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 8 passed (8)`, at `17b16000d7` and again at the final head `bd2646adfa` (after merging origin/main).
- **The flips have teeth.** Each mutation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which verified the anchor 1 -> 0 and the blob change, then restored blob == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty:
  - The deep-equal reverted to the code-less body gives `Tests 1 failed | 3 passed (4)`.
  - The error-sentences assert reverted to `'code' in body` false gives `Tests 2 failed | 2 passed (4)`.
- **Sibling hook-refusal files in shard 1** (`hook-after-abort-rollback`, `hook-after-condition-rollback`, `hook-capability-refusal`, `hook-error-format`, `hook-refusal-user-facing-marking`, `hook-runas-fls`, `lowered-body-door`, `organization-delete-refuse-nonempty`, `object-hook-lifecycle-showcase`) gave `Test Files 9 passed (9)`, `Tests 59 passed (59)`. A grep of `packages/qa/dogfood/test` finds no other pin asserting a code-less hook abort.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck` exits 0. The tsconfig `include` is `test/**/*`, so it covers both files.

## Acceptance notes

- The card records that the merge-queue run skipped the dogfood shards while the main push ran them, a filter-parity blind spot. This PR does not fix that, as the card says.
- `skip-changeset`: `@objectstack/dogfood` is `"private": true`, and the diff touches only its `test/` files, so nothing is published.

## Verification

The gates derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` were run locally on `bd2646adfa`, with each exit code captured before any pipe. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` was NOT MEASURED: it reported PREREQUISITE NOT MET because it needs a full `pnpm build` of unrelated packages. CI runs it. Full results are in the os-dev-report on #27806.
